+ 
+     /// Perform ANOVA analysis on quality metrics across groups
+     pub fn perform_anova(
+         &amp;self,
+         groups: &amp;[Vec&lt;f64&gt;],
+         group_names: &amp;[String],
+     ) -&gt; Result&lt;AnovaResult&gt; {
+         if groups.len() &lt; 2 {
+             anyhow::bail!(&quot;ANOVA requires at least 2 groups&quot;);
+         }
+ 
+         if groups.iter().any(|g| g.len() &lt; 2) {
+             anyhow::bail!(&quot;Each group must have at least 2 observations&quot;);
+         }
+ 
+         if groups.len() != group_names.len() {
+             anyhow::bail!(&quot;Number of groups must match number of group names&quot;);
+         }
+ 
+         // Calculate overall mean
+         let all_values: Vec&lt;f64&gt; = groups.iter().flatten().copied().collect();
+         let overall_mean = self.mean(&amp;all_values);
+ 
+         // Calculate SSB (Sum of Squares Between)
+         let mut ssb = 0.0;
+         let mut group_means = Vec::new();
+ 
+         for group in groups {
+             let group_mean = self.mean(group);
+             group_means.push(group_mean);
+             ssb += group.len() as f64 * (group_mean - overall_mean).powi(2);
+         }
+ 
+         // Calculate SSW (Sum of Squares Within)
+         let mut ssw = 0.0;
+         for (group, &amp;group_mean) in groups.iter().zip(&amp;group_means) {
+             for &amp;value in group {
+                 ssw += (value - group_mean).powi(2);
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         // Calculate SST (Sum of Squares Total)
+         let sst = ssb + ssw;
+ 
+         // Degrees of freedom
+         let df_between = groups.len() as f64 - 1.0;
+         let df_within = all_values.len() as f64 - groups.len() as f64;
+         let df_total = all_values.len() as f64 - 1.0;
+ 
+         // F-statistic
+         let f_statistic = if df_within &gt; 0.0 {
+             (ssb / df_between) / (ssw / df_within)
+         } else {
+             f64::INFINITY
+         };
+ 
+         // P-value approximation using F-distribution
+         let p_value = self.approximate_f_p_value(f_statistic, df_between, df_within);
+ 
+         // Effect size (eta squared)
+         let eta_squared = if sst &gt; 0.0 { ssb / sst } else { 0.0 };
+ 
+         let result = AnovaResult {
+             f_statistic,
+             df_between,
+             df_within,
+             df_total,
+             p_value,
+             is_significant: p_value &lt; self.config.alpha,
+             eta_squared,
+             group_means,
+             group_names: group_names.to_vec(),
+         };
+ 
+         info!(
+             &quot;ANOVA completed: F={:.3}, p={:.4}, significant={}&quot;,
+             f_statistic, p_value, result.is_significant
+         );
+ 
+         Ok(result)
+     }
+ 
+     /// Perform correlation analysis between two variables
+     pub fn analyze_correlation(&amp;self, x: &amp;[f64], y: &amp;[f64]) -&gt; Result&lt;CorrelationResult&gt; {
+         if x.len() != y.len() {
+             anyhow::bail!(&quot;X and Y arrays must have the same length&quot;);
+         }
+ 
+         if x.len() &lt; self.config.min_sample_size {
+             anyhow::bail!(&quot;Sample size {} is below minimum {}&quot;, x.len(), self.config.min_sample_size);
+         }
+ 
+         let n = x.len() as f64;
+ 
+         // Calculate means
+         let mean_x = self.mean(x);
+         let mean_y = self.mean(y);
+ 
+         // Calculate Pearson correlation
+         let mut numerator = 0.0;
+         let mut sum_sq_x = 0.0;
+         let mut sum_sq_y = 0.0;
+ 
+         for (&amp;xi, &amp;yi) in x.iter().zip(y) {
+             let dx = xi - mean_x;
+             let dy = yi - mean_y;
+             numerator += dx * dy;
+             sum_sq_x += dx * dx;
+             sum_sq_y += dy * dy;
+         }
+ 
+         let denominator = (sum_sq_x * sum_sq_y).sqrt();
+         let pearson_r = if denominator &gt; 0.0 {
+             numerator / denominator
+         } else {
+             0.0
+         };
+ 
+         // Calculate p-value using t-distribution
+         let t_statistic = pearson_r * ((n - 2.0) / (1.0 - pearson_r.powi(2))).sqrt();
+         let p_value = self.approximate_t_p_value(t_statistic, n - 2.0);
+ 
+         // Confidence interval
+         let se = ((1.0 - pearson_r.powi(2)) / (n - 3.0)).sqrt();
+         let z = self.normal_quantile(1.0 - (1.0 - self.config.confidence_level) / 2.0);
+         let margin = z * se;
+         let fisher_r = ((1.0 + pearson_r) / (1.0 - pearson_r)).ln();
+         let ci_lower = ((fisher_r - margin).exp() - 1.0) / ((fisher_r - margin).exp() + 1.0);
+         let ci_upper = ((fisher_r + margin).exp() - 1.0) / ((fisher_r + margin).exp() + 1.0);
+ 
+         // Spearman correlation (optional)
+         let spearman_rho = self.calculate_spearman_rho(x, y)?;
+ 
+         // Determine correlation strength
+         let strength = self.interpret_correlation_strength(pearson_r.abs());
+ 
+         let result = CorrelationResult {
+             pearson_r,
+             spearman_rho: Some(spearman_rho),
+             p_value,
+             n: x.len(),
+             confidence_interval: (ci_lower, ci_upper),
+             strength,
+         };
+ 
+         info!(
+             &quot;Correlation analysis: r={:.3}, p={:.4}, strength={:?}&quot;,
+             pearson_r, p_value, strength
+         );
+ 
+         Ok(result)
+     }
+ 
+     /// Perform quality trend analysis over time
+     pub fn analyze_quality_trends(&amp;self, metrics: &amp;[QualityMetric]) -&gt; Result&lt;TrendAnalysisResult&gt; {
+         if metrics.len() &lt; 3 {
+             anyhow::bail!(&quot;Trend analysis requires at least 3 data points&quot;);
+         }
+ 
+         // Group metrics by name
+         let mut metric_groups: HashMap&lt;String, Vec&lt;&amp;QualityMetric&gt;&gt; = HashMap::new();
+         for metric in metrics {
+             metric_groups.entry(metric.name.clone()).or_default().push(metric);
+         }
+ 
+         let mut trend_results = HashMap::new();
+ 
+         for (metric_name, group_metrics) in metric_groups {
+             if group_metrics.len() &lt; 3 {
+                 continue; // Skip metrics with insufficient data
+             }
+ 
+             // Sort by timestamp
+             let mut sorted_metrics = group_metrics.clone();
+             sorted_metrics.sort_by_key(|m| m.timestamp);
+ 
+             // Extract values and timestamps
+             let values: Vec&lt;f64&gt; = sorted_metrics.iter().map(|m| m.value).collect();
+             let timestamps: Vec&lt;i64&gt; = sorted_metrics.iter()
+                 .map(|m| m.timestamp.timestamp())
+                 .collect();
+ 
+             // Perform linear regression

+ 
+             // Calculate trend strength and direction
+             let trend_direction = if regression.slope &gt; 0.01 {
+                 TrendDirection::Improving
+             } else if regression.slope &lt; -0.01 {
+                 TrendDirection::Declining
+             } else {
+                 TrendDirection::Stable
+             };
+ 
+             let trend_strength = regression.r_squared;
+ 
+             trend_results.insert(metric_name, TrendResult {
+                 slope: regression.slope,
+                 intercept: regression.intercept,
+                 r_squared: regression.r_squared,
+                 p_value: regression.p_value,
+                 direction: trend_direction,
+                 strength: self.interpret_trend_strength(trend_strength),
+                 data_points: sorted_metrics.len(),
+             });
+         }
+ 
+         Ok(TrendAnalysisResult {
+             trends: trend_results,
+             analysis_period_days: self.calculate_analysis_period(metrics),
+             total_data_points: metrics.len(),
+         })
+     }
+ 
+     /// Calculate basic descriptive statistics
+     pub fn descriptive_statistics(&amp;self, data: &amp;[f64]) -&gt; Result&lt;DescriptiveStats&gt; {
+         if data.is_empty() {
+             anyhow::bail!(&quot;Cannot calculate statistics for empty data&quot;);
+         }
+ 
+         let n = data.len() as f64;
+         let mean = self.mean(data);
+         let variance = self.variance(data, mean);
+         let std_dev = variance.sqrt();
+ 
+         let mut sorted_data = data.to_vec();
+         sorted_data.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap());
+ 
+         let median = if sorted_data.len() % 2 == 0 {
+             (sorted_data[sorted_data.len() / 2 - 1] + sorted_data[sorted_data.len() / 2]) / 2.0
+         } else {
+             sorted_data[sorted_data.len() / 2]
+         };
+ 
+         let q1 = self.percentile(&amp;sorted_data, 25.0);
+         let q3 = self.percentile(&amp;sorted_data, 75.0);
+         let iqr = q3 - q1;
+ 
+         // Outlier bounds
+         let lower_bound = q1 - 1.5 * iqr;
+         let upper_bound = q3 + 1.5 * iqr;
+ 
+         let min = *sorted_data.first().unwrap();
+         let max = *sorted_data.last().unwrap();
+         let range = max - min;
+ 
+         // Skewness and kurtosis
+         let skewness = self.skewness(data, mean, std_dev);
+         let kurtosis = self.kurtosis(data, mean, std_dev);
+ 
+         Ok(DescriptiveStats {
+             count: data.len(),
+             mean,
+             median,
+             mode: self.mode(data),
+             std_dev,
+             variance,
+             min,
+             max,
+             range,
+             q1,
+             q3,
+             iqr,
+             lower_bound,
+             upper_bound,
+             skewness,
+             kurtosis,
+             outliers: self.detect_outliers(data, lower_bound, upper_bound),
+         })
+     }
+ 
+     // Helper methods
+ 
+     fn mean(&amp;self, data: &amp;[f64]) -&gt; f64 {
+         data.iter().sum::&lt;f64&gt;() / data.len() as f64
+     }
+ 
+     fn variance(&amp;self, data: &amp;[f64], mean: f64) -&gt; f64 {
+         data.iter().map(|x| (x - mean).powi(2)).sum::&lt;f64&gt;() / (data.len() - 1) as f64
+     }
+ 
+     fn percentile(&amp;self, sorted_data: &amp;[f64], p: f64) -&gt; f64 {
+         if sorted_data.is_empty() {
+             return 0.0;
+         }
+ 
+         let index = (p / 100.0 * (sorted_data.len() - 1) as f64).floor() as usize;
+         sorted_data[index]
+     }
+ 
+     fn mode(&amp;self, data: &amp;[f64]) -&gt; Option&lt;f64&gt; {
+         let mut counts = HashMap::new();
+         for &amp;value in data {
+             *counts.entry((value * 1000.0) as i64).or_insert(0) += 1; // Round to avoid floating point issues
+         }
+ 
+         counts.into_iter()
+             .max_by_key(|&amp;(_, count)| count)
+             .map(|(value, _)| value as f64 / 1000.0)
+     }
+ 
+     fn skewness(&amp;self, data: &amp;[f64], mean: f64, std_dev: f64) -&gt; f64 {
+         if std_dev == 0.0 {
+             return 0.0;
+         }
+ 
+         let n = data.len() as f64;
+         data.iter()
+             .map(|x| ((x - mean) / std_dev).powi(3))
+             .sum::&lt;f64&gt;() / n
+     }
+ 
+     fn kurtosis(&amp;self, data: &amp;[f64], mean: f64, std_dev: f64) -&gt; f64 {
+         if std_dev == 0.0 {
+             return 0.0;
+         }
+ 
+         let n = data.len() as f64;
+         data.iter()
+             .map(|x| ((x - mean) / std_dev).powi(4))
+             .sum::&lt;f64&gt;() / n - 3.0
+     }
+ 
+     fn detect_outliers(&amp;self, data: &amp;[f64], lower_bound: f64, upper_bound: f64) -&gt; Vec&lt;f64&gt; {
+         data.iter()
+             .filter(|&amp;&amp;x| x &lt; lower_bound || x &gt; upper_bound)
+             .copied()
+             .collect()
+     }
+ 
+     fn calculate_spearman_rho(&amp;self, x: &amp;[f64], y: &amp;[f64]) -&gt; Result&lt;f64&gt; {
+         // Convert to ranks
+         let x_ranks = self.rank_data(x)?;
+         let y_ranks = self.rank_data(y)?;
+ 
+         // Calculate correlation between ranks
+         self.analyze_correlation(&amp;x_ranks, &amp;y_ranks).map(|r| r.pearson_r)
+     }
+ 
+     fn rank_data(&amp;self, data: &amp;[f64]) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;f64&gt;&gt; {
+         let mut indexed: Vec&lt;(usize, f64)&gt; = data.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, &amp;v)| (i, v)).collect();
+         indexed.sort_by(|a, b| a.1.partial_cmp(&amp;b.1).unwrap());
+ 
+         let mut ranks = vec![0.0; data.len()];
+         let mut i = 0;
+ 
+         while i &lt; indexed.len() {
+             let mut j = i;
+             while j &lt; indexed.len() &amp;&amp; indexed[j].1 == indexed[i].1 {
+                 j += 1;
+             }
+ 
+             // Average rank for tied values
+             let avg_rank = ((i + j - 1) as f64 + 2.0) / 2.0;
+             for k in i..j {
+                 ranks[indexed[k].0] = avg_rank;
+             }
+ 
+             i = j;
+         }
+ 
+         Ok(ranks)
+     }
+ 
+     fn linear_regression(&amp;self, x: &amp;[i64], y: &amp;[f64]) -&gt; Result&lt;RegressionResult&gt; {
+         if x.len() != y.len() || x.len() &lt; 2 {
+             anyhow::bail!(&quot;Invalid data for regression&quot;);
+         }
+ 
+         let n = x.len() as f64;
+         let sum_x: f64 = x.iter().map(|&amp;xi| xi as f64).sum();
+         let sum_y: f64 = y.iter().sum();
+         let sum_xy: f64 = x.iter().zip(y).map(|(&amp;xi, &amp;yi)| xi as f64 * yi).sum();
+         let sum_x2: f64 = x.iter().map(|&amp;xi| (xi as f64).powi(2)).sum();
+         let sum_y2: f64 = y.iter().map(|yi| yi.powi(2)).sum();
+ 
+         let slope = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x.powi(2));
+         let intercept = (sum_y - slope * sum_x) / n;
+ 
+         // Calculate R-squared
+         let y_mean = sum_y / n;
+         let ss_tot: f64 = y.iter().map(|&amp;yi| (yi - y_mean).powi(2)).sum();
+         let ss_res: f64 = x.iter().zip(y).map(|(&amp;xi, &amp;yi)| {
+             let predicted = slope * xi as f64 + intercept;
+             (yi - predicted).powi(2)
+         }).sum();
+ 
+         let r_squared = if ss_tot &gt; 0.0 { 1.0 - (ss_res / ss_tot) } else { 0.0 };
+ 
+         // F-statistic and p-value for regression
+         let f_statistic = (r_squared / (1.0 - r_squared)) * ((n - 2.0) / 1.0);
+         let p_value = self.approximate_f_p_value(f_statistic, 1.0, n - 2.0);
+ 
+         Ok(RegressionResult {
+             slope,
+             intercept,
+             r_squared,
+             p_value,
+         })
+     }
+ 
+     fn approximate_f_p_value(&amp;self, f: f64, df1: f64, df2: f64) -&gt; f64 {
+         // Simplified approximation using beta distribution
+         if f &lt;= 0.0 {
+             return 1.0;
+         }
+ 
+         // Use beta incomplete function approximation
+         let x = df2 / (df2 + df1 * f);
+         self.beta_incomplete(df2 / 2.0, df1 / 2.0, x)
+     }
+ 
+     fn approximate_t_p_value(&amp;self, t: f64, df: f64) -&gt; f64 {
+         // Approximation for t-distribution p-value
+         let x = df / (t.powi(2) + df);
+         1.0 - self.beta_incomplete(df / 2.0, 0.5, x)
+     }
+ 
+     fn beta_incomplete(&amp;self, a: f64, b: f64, x: f64) -&gt; f64 {
+         // Simplified beta incomplete function approximation
+         // This is a rough approximation - in production, use a proper statistical library
+         if x &lt;= 0.0 {
+             return 0.0;
+         }
+         if x &gt;= 1.0 {
+             return 1.0;
+         }
+ 
+         // Use series expansion for beta incomplete
+         let mut result = 0.0;
+         let mut term = 1.0;
+         let max_terms = 20;
+ 
+         for i in 0..max_terms {
+             if i &gt; 0 {
+                 term *= (a + i as f64 - 1.0) * x / (a + b + i as f64 - 1.0);
+             }
+             result += term;
+             if term.abs() &lt; 1e-10 {
+                 break;
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         result
+     }
+ 
+     fn normal_quantile(&amp;self, p: f64) -&gt; f64 {
+         // Approximation of normal quantile function
+         // This is a rough approximation - in production, use a proper statistical library
+         if p &lt;= 0.0 {
+             return f64::NEG_INFINITY;
+         }
+         if p &gt;= 1.0 {
+             return f64::INFINITY;
+         }
+ 
+         // Use approximation formula
+         let sqrt_2 = (2.0_f64).sqrt();
+         let a1 = -3.969683028665376e1;
+         let a2 = 2.209460984245205e2;
+         let a3 = -2.759285104469687e2;
+         let a4 = 1.383577518672690e2;
+         let a5 = -3.066479806614716e1;
+         let a6 = 2.506628277459239e0;
+ 
+         let b1 = -5.447609879822406e1;
+         let b2 = 1.615858368580409e2;
+         let b3 = -1.556989798598866e2;
+         let b4 = 6.680131188771972e1;
+         let b5 = -1.328068155288572e1;
+ 
+         let c1 = -7.784894002430293e-3;
+         let c2 = -3.223964580411365e-1;
+         let c3 = -2.400758277161838e0;
+         let c4 = -2.549732539343734e0;
+         let c5 = 4.374664141464968e0;
+         let c6 = 2.938163982698783e0;
+ 
+         let d1 = 7.784695709041462e-3;
+         let d2 = 3.224671290700398e-1;
+         let d3 = 2.445134137142996e0;
+         let d4 = 3.754408661907416e0;
+ 
+         let q = p - 0.5;
+ 
+         if q.abs() &lt;= 0.425 {
+             let r = 0.180625 - q * q;
+             q * (((((a1 * r + a2) * r + a3) * r + a4) * r + a5) * r + a6) /
+             (((((b1 * r + b2) * r + b3) * r + b4) * r + b5) * r + 1.0)
+         } else {
+             let r = if q &gt; 0.0 { 1.0 - p } else { p };
+             let r_sqrt = (-r.ln()).sqrt();
+             let r_val = (((((c1 * r_sqrt + c2) * r_sqrt + c3) * r_sqrt + c4) * r_sqrt + c5) * r_sqrt + c6) /
+                        ((((d1 * r_sqrt + d2) * r_sqrt + d3) * r_sqrt + d4) * r_sqrt + 1.0);
+ 
+             if q &lt; 0.0 { -r_val } else { r_val }
+         }
+     }

+         match r.abs() {

+             r if r &lt; 0.4 =&gt; CorrelationStrength::Weak,

+         let min_ts = timestamps.iter().min().unwrap();
+         let max_ts = timestamps.iter().max().unwrap();

+     // Internal methods

+     fn initialize_quantum_state(&amp;mut self, num_states: usize) -&gt; QuantumState {
+         let mut amplitudes = Vec::with_capacity(num_states);
+         let mut phases = Vec::with_capacity(num_states);
+ 
+         // Equal superposition
+         let amplitude = 1.0 / (num_states as f64).sqrt();
+ 
+         for _ in 0..num_states {
+             amplitudes.push(amplitude);
+             phases.push(self.rng.gen_range(0.0..2.0 * std::f64::consts::PI));
+         }
+ 
+         // Initialize entanglement matrix
+         let mut entanglement = vec![vec![0.0; num_states]; num_states];
+         for i in 0..num_states {
+             entanglement[i][i] = 1.0; // Self-entanglement
+             for j in (i + 1)..num_states {
+                 // Random entanglement strength
+                 let strength = self.config.entanglement_strength * self.rng.gen::&lt;f64&gt;();
+                 entanglement[i][j] = strength;
+                 entanglement[j][i] = strength;
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         QuantumState {
+             amplitudes,
+             phases,
+             entanglement,
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     async fn simulate_ai_review(&amp;mut self, code_options: &amp;[String], ai_name: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;AIScore&gt;&gt; {
+         let mut scores = Vec::new();
+ 
+         for (i, code) in code_options.iter().enumerate() {
+             // Simulate AI review with some randomness and code quality assessment
+             let base_score = self.assess_code_quality(code);
+             let noise = self.rng.gen_range(-0.1..0.1);
+             let quality_score = (base_score + noise).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
+ 
+             let confidence = 0.8 + self.rng.gen_range(-0.1..0.1);
+ 
+             let feedback = format!(
+                 &quot;AI {} review of option {}: quality score {:.2}&quot;,
+                 ai_name, i + 1, quality_score
+             );
+ 
+             let recommendations = vec![
+                 &quot;Consider error handling improvements&quot;.to_string(),
+                 &quot;Optimize performance bottlenecks&quot;.to_string(),
+                 &quot;Enhance code readability&quot;.to_string(),
+             ];
+ 
+             scores.push(AIScore {
+                 ai_name: ai_name.to_string(),
+                 quality_score,
+                 confidence,
+                 feedback,
+                 recommendations,
+             });
+         }
+ 
+         Ok(scores)
+     }
+ 
+     fn assess_code_quality(&amp;self, code: &amp;str) -&gt; f64 {
+         // Simple heuristic-based code quality assessment
+         let mut score = 0.5; // Base score
+ 
+         // Length factor
+         let length_score = (code.len() as f64 / 1000.0).min(1.0);
+         score += length_score * 0.1;
+ 
+         // Comment ratio
+         let comment_lines = code.lines().filter(|line| line.trim().starts_with(&quot;//&quot;)).count();
+         let total_lines = code.lines().count();
+         let comment_ratio = if total_lines &gt; 0 { comment_lines as f64 / total_lines as f64 } else { 0.0 };
+         score += comment_ratio * 0.2;
+ 
+         // Error handling presence
+         let has_error_handling = code.contains(&quot;Result&lt;&quot;) || code.contains(&quot;try&quot;) || code.contains(&quot;catch&quot;);
+         if has_error_handling {
+             score += 0.1;
+         }
+ 
+         // Function complexity (simple heuristic)
+         let function_count = code.matches(&quot;fn &quot;).count();
+         let complexity_penalty = (function_count as f64 / 10.0).min(0.2);
+         score -= complexity_penalty;
+ 
+         score.clamp(0.0, 1.0)
+     }
+ 
+     fn apply_consensus_gates(&amp;mut self, state: &amp;mut QuantumState, ai_scores: &amp;[AIScore]) {
+         // Apply quantum gates based on AI consensus
+         for i in 0..state.amplitudes.len() {
+             let mut consensus_factor = 0.0;
+ 
+             // Aggregate AI scores for this option
+             let option_scores: Vec&lt;f64&gt; = ai_scores.iter()
+                 .filter(|score| score.ai_name.contains(&amp;format!(&quot;{}&quot;, i + 1)))
+                 .map(|score| score.quality_score)
+                 .collect();
+ 
+             if !option_scores.is_empty() {
+                 consensus_factor = option_scores.iter().sum::&lt;f64&gt;() / option_scores.len() as f64;
+             }
+ 
+             // Apply phase shift based on consensus
+             state.phases[i] += consensus_factor * std::f64::consts::PI / 4.0;
+ 
+             // Update amplitude
+             state.amplitudes[i] *= (1.0 + consensus_factor) / (1.0 + state.amplitudes.len() as f64).sqrt();
+         }
+ 
+         // Normalize amplitudes
+         self.normalize_quantum_state(state);
+     }
+ 
+     fn apply_entanglement(&amp;mut self, state: &amp;mut QuantumState) {
+         for i in 0..state.amplitudes.len() {
+             for j in (i + 1)..state.amplitudes.len() {
+                 let entanglement_strength = state.entanglement[i][j];
+ 
+                 // Apply entanglement operation
+                 let phase_diff = state.phases[i] - state.phases[j];
+                 let entanglement_factor = (phase_diff.cos() * entanglement_strength).abs();
+ 
+                 // Correlate amplitudes
+                 let avg_amplitude = (state.amplitudes[i] + state.amplitudes[j]) / 2.0;
+                 state.amplitudes[i] = avg_amplitude * (1.0 + entanglement_factor);
+                 state.amplitudes[j] = avg_amplitude * (1.0 - entanglement_factor);
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         self.normalize_quantum_state(state);
+     }
+ 
+     fn apply_decoherence(&amp;mut self, state: &amp;mut QuantumState) {
+         for amplitude in &amp;mut state.amplitudes {
+             let noise = self.rng.gen_range(-self.config.noise_factor..self.config.noise_factor);
+             *amplitude *= 1.0 + noise;
+         }
+ 
+         for phase in &amp;mut state.phases {
+             let noise = self.rng.gen_range(-self.config.noise_factor..self.config.noise_factor);
+             *phase += noise;
+         }
+ 
+         self.normalize_quantum_state(state);
+     }
+ 
+     fn quantum_annealing_step(&amp;mut self, state: &amp;mut QuantumState, temperature: f64) {
+         // Simulated annealing in quantum space
+         let cooling_factor = 1.0 - temperature;
+ 
+         for i in 0..state.amplitudes.len() {
+             // Probabilistic amplitude update
+             if self.rng.gen::&lt;f64&gt;() &lt; cooling_factor {
+                 let neighbor_boost = self.rng.gen_range(0.8..1.2);
+                 state.amplitudes[i] *= neighbor_boost;
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         self.normalize_quantum_state(state);
+     }
+ 
+     fn calculate_entropy(&amp;self, state: &amp;QuantumState) -&gt; f64 {
+         state.amplitudes.iter()
+             .map(|&amp;amp| {
+                 let prob = amp.powi(2);
+                 if prob &gt; 0.0 { -prob * prob.ln() } else { 0.0 }
+             })
+             .sum()
+     }
+ 
+     fn check_convergence(&amp;self, entropy_history: &amp;[f64]) -&gt; bool {
+         if entropy_history.len() &lt; 2 {
+             return false;
+         }
+ 
+         let recent_change = (entropy_history.last().unwrap() - entropy_history[entropy_history.len() - 2]).abs();
+         recent_change &lt; self.config.convergence_threshold
+     }
+ 
+     fn measure_quantum_state(&amp;mut self, state: &amp;QuantumState) -&gt; usize {

+             .enumerate()

+             .collect();
+ 
+         probabilities.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&amp;a.1).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
+ 
+         probabilities[0].0 // Return index of highest probability state
+     }

+     fn calculate_confidence(&amp;self, state: &amp;QuantumState, optimal_index: usize) -&gt; f64 {

+         let total_prob: f64 = state.amplitudes.iter().map(|amp| amp.powi(2)).sum();

+         if total_prob &gt; 0.0 {
+             optimal_prob / total_prob
+         } else {
+             0.0
+         }

+     fn generate_quality_metrics(&amp;self, ai_scores: &amp;[AIScore], optimal_index: usize) -&gt; HashMap&lt;String, f64&gt; {
+         let mut metrics = HashMap::new();

+         // Filter scores for optimal option

+         if !option_scores.is_empty() {

+             let variance = option_scores.iter()

+     fn assess_risk(&amp;self, metrics: &amp;HashMap&lt;String, f64&gt;) -&gt; RiskLevel {

+             .filter(|&amp;i| self.is_pareto_optimal(i, candidates, criteria))
+             .collect();

+         // Boost amplitudes of Pareto optimal solutions

+             .filter(|&amp;i| self.is_pareto_optimal(i, candidates, criteria))
+             .count();
+ 
+         // Consider converged if we have a stable Pareto front
+         pareto_count &gt;= candidates.len() / 3
+     }

+     fn extract_pareto_front(

+         state: &amp;QuantumState,
+         candidates: &amp;[CodeCandidate],

+     ) -&gt; Vec&lt;usize&gt; {

+     fn select_optimal_from_pareto(
+         &amp;self,
+         pareto_solutions: &amp;[usize],
+         criteria: &amp;[OptimizationCriterion],
+     ) -&gt; usize {
+         if pareto_solutions.is_empty() {
+             return 0;
+         }
+ 
+         // Select solution with highest weighted fitness
+         let mut best_index = pareto_solutions[0];
+         let mut best_score = 0.0;
+ 
+         for &amp;index in pareto_solutions {
+             let score: f64 = criteria.iter()
+                 .map(|criterion| {
+                     let fitness = self.evaluate_fitness(&amp;CodeCandidate::default(), &amp;QuantumOperator {
+                         weight: criterion.weight,
+                         direction: criterion.direction,
+                         operator_type: QuantumOperatorType::PhaseShift,
+                     });
+                     fitness * criterion.weight
+                 })
+                 .sum();
+ 
+             if score &gt; best_score {
+                 best_score = score;
+                 best_index = index;
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         best_index
+     }
+ 
+     fn calculate_optimization_score(&amp;self, state: &amp;QuantumState, index: usize) -&gt; f64 {
+         state.amplitudes[index].powi(2)
+     }
+ 
+     // Helper methods for multi-objective optimization
+ 
+     fn is_pareto_optimal(
+         &amp;self,
+         index: usize,
+         candidates: &amp;[CodeCandidate],
+         criteria: &amp;[OptimizationCriterion],
+     ) -&gt; bool {
+         for (other_index, other_candidate) in candidates.iter().enumerate() {
+             if index == other_index {
+                 continue;
+             }
+ 
+             let mut dominated = true;
+ 
+             for criterion in criteria {
+                 let fitness_a = self.evaluate_fitness(&amp;candidates[index], &amp;QuantumOperator {
+                     weight: criterion.weight,
+                     direction: criterion.direction,
+                     operator_type: QuantumOperatorType::PhaseShift,
+                 });
+                 let fitness_b = self.evaluate_fitness(other_candidate, &amp;QuantumOperator {
+                     weight: criterion.weight,
+                     direction: criterion.direction,
+                     operator_type: QuantumOperatorType::PhaseShift,
+                 });
+ 
+                 match criterion.direction {
+                     OptimizationDirection::Maximize =&gt; {
+                         if fitness_a &lt; fitness_b {
+                             dominated = false;
+                             break;
+                         }
+                     }
+                     OptimizationDirection::Minimize =&gt; {
+                         if fitness_a &gt; fitness_b {
+                             dominated = false;
+                             break;
+                         }
+                     }
+                 }
+             }
+ 
+             if dominated {
+                 return false;
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         true
+     }

+             }
+         }
+     }

+ import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from &#39;react&#39;;
+ import { invoke } from &#39;@tauri-apps/api/core&#39;;
+ import { z } from &#39;zod&#39;;
+ 
+ // Zod schemas for type safety
+ const TaskStatusSchema = z.union([
+   z.literal(&#39;todo&#39;),
+   z.literal(&#39;inProgress&#39;),
+   z.literal(&#39;review&#39;),
+   z.literal(&#39;done&#39;),
+ ]);
+ 
+ const ProjectTaskSchema = z.object({
+   readonly id: z.string(),
+   readonly title: z.string(),
+   readonly description: z.string().optional(),
+   readonly assignedAgent: z.string().optional(),
+   readonly status: TaskStatusSchema,
+   readonly dueDate: z.string().optional(),
+   readonly priority: z.union([z.literal(&#39;low&#39;), z.literal(&#39;medium&#39;), z.literal(&#39;high&#39;)]),
+   readonly progress: z.number().min(0).max(100),
+ });
+ 
+ const GanttChartDataSchema = z.object({
+   readonly tasks: z.array(ProjectTaskSchema),
+   readonly dependencies: z.array(z.object({
+     readonly from: z.string(),
+     readonly to: z.string(),
+   })),
+ });
+ 
+ type TaskStatus = z.infer&lt;typeof TaskStatusSchema&gt;;
+ type ProjectTask = z.infer&lt;typeof ProjectTaskSchema&gt;;
+ type GanttChartData = z.infer&lt;typeof GanttChartDataSchema&gt;;
+ 
+ interface GanttChartProps {
+   readonly className?: string;
+   readonly height?: number;
+   readonly onTaskClick?: (task: ProjectTask) =&gt; void;
+   readonly onTaskUpdate?: (taskId: string, updates: Partial&lt;ProjectTask&gt;) =&gt; void;
+ }
+ 
+ // Gantt chart configuration
+ const GANTT_CONFIG = {
+   rowHeight: 40,
+   headerHeight: 50,
+   timelineHeight: 30,
+   dayWidth: 30,
+   startDate: new Date(),
+   weeksToShow: 12,
+ } as const;
+ 
+ // Status color mapping
+ const STATUS_COLORS: Record&lt;TaskStatus, string&gt; = {
+   todo: &#39;#6b7280&#39;,
+   inProgress: &#39;#3b82f6&#39;,
+   review: &#39;#f59e0b&#39;,
+   done: &#39;#10b981&#39;,
+ };
+ 
+ // Priority color mapping
+ const PRIORITY_COLORS = {
+   low: &#39;#6b7280&#39;,
+   medium: &#39;#f59e0b&#39;,
+   high: &#39;#ef4444&#39;,
+ } as const;
+ 
+ export const GanttChart: React.FC&lt;GanttChartProps&gt; = ({
+   className = &#39;&#39;,
+   height = 600,
+   onTaskClick,
+   onTaskUpdate,
+ }) =&gt; {
+   const canvasRef = useRef&lt;HTMLCanvasElement&gt;(null);
+   const containerRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null);
+   const [data, setData] = useState&lt;GanttChartData | null&gt;(null);
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+   const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);
+   const [selectedTask, setSelectedTask] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);
+   const [hoveredTask, setHoveredTask] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);
+ 
+   // Load gantt chart data
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     loadGanttData();
+   }, []);
+ 
+   // Draw gantt chart when data changes
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (data &amp;&amp; canvasRef.current) {
+       drawGanttChart();
+     }
+   }, [data, selectedTask, hoveredTask]);
+ 
+   const loadGanttData = async () =&gt; {
+     try {
+       setLoading(true);
+       setError(null);
+ 
+       // Load project tasks and dependencies
+       const tasks = await invoke&lt;ProjectTask[]&gt;(&#39;get_project_tasks&#39;);
+       const dependencies = await invoke&lt;Array&lt;{ from: string; to: string }&gt;&gt;(&#39;get_task_dependencies&#39;);
+ 
+       const validatedData = GanttChartDataSchema.parse({
+         tasks,
+         dependencies,
+       });
+ 
+       setData(validatedData);
+     } catch (err) {
+       console.error(&#39;Failed to load gantt data:&#39;, err);
+       setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : &#39;Failed to load gantt data&#39;);
+     } finally {
+       setLoading(false);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const drawGanttChart = () =&gt; {
+     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
+     const container = containerRef.current;
+     if (!canvas || !container || !data) return;
+ 
+     const ctx = canvas.getContext(&#39;2d&#39;);
+     if (!ctx) return;
+ 
+     // Set canvas size
+     const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
+     canvas.width = rect.width * window.devicePixelRatio;
+     canvas.height = rect.height * window.devicePixelRatio;
+     ctx.scale(window.devicePixelRatio, window.devicePixelRatio);
+ 
+     // Clear canvas
+     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, rect.width, rect.height);
+ 
+     // Draw background
+     ctx.fillStyle = &#39;#f8fafc&#39;;
+     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, rect.width, rect.height);
+ 
+     // Draw grid lines
+     drawGrid(ctx, rect.width, rect.height);
+ 
+     // Draw timeline header
+     drawTimelineHeader(ctx);
+ 
+     // Draw tasks
+     drawTasks(ctx, data.tasks, rect.width);
+ 
+     // Draw dependencies
+     drawDependencies(ctx, data.tasks, data.dependencies);
+   };
+ 
+   const drawGrid = (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, width: number, height: number) =&gt; {
+     ctx.strokeStyle = &#39;#e2e8f0&#39;;
+     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
+ 
+     // Vertical lines (days)
+     for (let x = 0; x &lt; width; x += GANTT_CONFIG.dayWidth) {
+       ctx.beginPath();
+       ctx.moveTo(x, GANTT_CONFIG.headerHeight);
+       ctx.lineTo(x, height);
+       ctx.stroke();
+     }
+ 
+     // Horizontal lines (tasks)
+     for (let y = GANTT_CONFIG.headerHeight; y &lt; height; y += GANTT_CONFIG.rowHeight) {
+       ctx.beginPath();
+       ctx.moveTo(0, y);
+       ctx.lineTo(width, y);
+       ctx.stroke();
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const drawTimelineHeader = (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D) =&gt; {
+     ctx.fillStyle = &#39;#1e293b&#39;;
+     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 200, GANTT_CONFIG.headerHeight);
+ 
+     ctx.fillStyle = &#39;#64748b&#39;;
+     ctx.font = &#39;12px monospace&#39;;
+     ctx.textAlign = &#39;center&#39;;
+ 
+     // Draw week headers
+     for (let week = 0; week &lt; GANTT_CONFIG.weeksToShow; week++) {
+       const x = 200 + week * 7 * GANTT_CONFIG.dayWidth;
+       const date = new Date(GANTT_CONFIG.startDate);
+       date.setDate(date.getDate() + week * 7);
+ 
+       ctx.fillText(&#96;Week ${week + 1}&#96;, x + (7 * GANTT_CONFIG.dayWidth) / 2, GANTT_CONFIG.headerHeight - 15);
+       ctx.fillText(date.toLocaleDateString(), x + (7 * GANTT_CONFIG.dayWidth) / 2, GANTT_CONFIG.headerHeight - 5);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const drawTasks = (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, tasks: readonly ProjectTask[], canvasWidth: number) =&gt; {
+     tasks.forEach((task, index) =&gt; {
+       const y = GANTT_CONFIG.headerHeight + index * GANTT_CONFIG.rowHeight;
+       const taskWidth = Math.max(50, task.progress * 2); // Progress-based width
+       const x = 200 + Math.random() * (canvasWidth - 200 - taskWidth); // Random position for demo
+ 
+       // Draw task bar background
+       ctx.fillStyle = STATUS_COLORS[task.status];
+       ctx.fillRect(x, y + 5, taskWidth, GANTT_CONFIG.rowHeight - 10);
+ 
+       // Draw progress indicator
+       if (task.progress &gt; 0) {
+         ctx.fillStyle = &#39;#ffffff80&#39;;
+         ctx.fillRect(x, y + 5, (taskWidth * task.progress) / 100, GANTT_CONFIG.rowHeight - 10);
+       }
+ 
+       // Draw task label
+       ctx.fillStyle = &#39;#ffffff&#39;;
+       ctx.font = &#39;12px monospace&#39;;
+       ctx.textAlign = &#39;left&#39;;
+       ctx.fillText(task.title, x + 5, y + GANTT_CONFIG.rowHeight / 2 + 4);
+ 
+       // Draw priority indicator
+       ctx.fillStyle = PRIORITY_COLORS[task.priority];
+       ctx.fillRect(x - 15, y + 10, 10, GANTT_CONFIG.rowHeight - 20);
+ 
+       // Highlight selected/hovered task
+       if (selectedTask === task.id || hoveredTask === task.id) {
+         ctx.strokeStyle = &#39;#3b82f6&#39;;
+         ctx.lineWidth = 2;
+         ctx.strokeRect(x - 2, y + 3, taskWidth + 4, GANTT_CONFIG.rowHeight - 6);
+       }
+     });
+   };
+ 
+   const drawDependencies = (
+     ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
+     tasks: readonly ProjectTask[],
+     dependencies: readonly { readonly from: string; readonly to: string }[]
+   ) =&gt; {
+     ctx.strokeStyle = &#39;#6b7280&#39;;
+     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
+ 
+     dependencies.forEach(dep =&gt; {
+       const fromTask = tasks.find(t =&gt; t.id === dep.from);
+       const toTask = tasks.find(t =&gt; t.id === dep.to);
+ 
+       if (fromTask &amp;&amp; toTask) {
+         const fromIndex = tasks.indexOf(fromTask);
+         const toIndex = tasks.indexOf(toTask);
+ 
+         const fromY = GANTT_CONFIG.headerHeight + fromIndex * GANTT_CONFIG.rowHeight + GANTT_CONFIG.rowHeight / 2;
+         const toY = GANTT_CONFIG.headerHeight + toIndex * GANTT_CONFIG.rowHeight + GANTT_CONFIG.rowHeight / 2;
+ 
+         // Draw dependency arrow
+         ctx.beginPath();
+         ctx.moveTo(180, fromY);
+         ctx.lineTo(200, fromY);
+         ctx.lineTo(200, toY);
+         ctx.lineTo(220, toY);
+         ctx.stroke();
+ 
+         // Draw arrowhead
+         ctx.beginPath();
+         ctx.moveTo(220, toY);
+         ctx.lineTo(215, toY - 3);
+         ctx.lineTo(215, toY + 3);
+         ctx.closePath();
+         ctx.fillStyle = &#39;#6b7280&#39;;
+         ctx.fill();
+       }
+     });
+   };
+ 
+   const handleCanvasClick = (event: React.MouseEvent&lt;HTMLCanvasElement&gt;) =&gt; {
+     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
+     if (!canvas || !data) return;
+ 
+     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
+     const x = event.clientX - rect.left;
+     const y = event.clientY - rect.top;
+ 
+     // Check if clicked on a task
+     data.tasks.forEach((task, index) =&gt; {
+       const taskY = GANTT_CONFIG.headerHeight + index * GANTT_CONFIG.rowHeight;
+       const taskHeight = GANTT_CONFIG.rowHeight;
+ 
+       if (y &gt;= taskY &amp;&amp; y &lt;= taskY + taskHeight &amp;&amp; x &gt;= 200) {
+         setSelectedTask(task.id);
+         onTaskClick?.(task);
+       }
+     });
+   };
+ 
+   const handleCanvasMouseMove = (event: React.MouseEvent&lt;HTMLCanvasElement&gt;) =&gt; {
+     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
+     if (!canvas || !data) return;
+ 
+     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
+     const x = event.clientX - rect.left;
+     const y = event.clientY - rect.top;
+ 
+     let foundTask = null;
+ 
+     // Check if hovering over a task
+     data.tasks.forEach((task, index) =&gt; {
+       const taskY = GANTT_CONFIG.headerHeight + index * GANTT_CONFIG.rowHeight;
+       const taskHeight = GANTT_CONFIG.rowHeight;
+ 
+       if (y &gt;= taskY &amp;&amp; y &lt;= taskY + taskHeight &amp;&amp; x &gt;= 200) {
+         foundTask = task.id;
+       }
+     });
+ 
+     setHoveredTask(foundTask);
+   };
+ 
+   if (loading) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className={&#96;flex items-center justify-center ${className}&#96;} style={{ height }}&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;text-gray-500&quot;&gt;Loading Gantt Chart...&lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   if (error) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className={&#96;flex items-center justify-center ${className}&#96;} style={{ height }}&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;text-red-500&quot;&gt;Error: {error}&lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div ref={containerRef} className={&#96;border border-gray-200 rounded-lg overflow-hidden ${className}&#96;}&gt;
+       &lt;div className=&quot;bg-gray-50 px-4 py-2 border-b border-gray-200&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;h3 className=&quot;text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900&quot;&gt;Project Gantt Chart&lt;/h3&gt;
+         &lt;p className=&quot;text-sm text-gray-600&quot;&gt;Visualize project timeline and dependencies&lt;/p&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;div className=&quot;relative&quot; style={{ height }}&gt;
+         &lt;canvas
+           ref={canvasRef}
+           className=&quot;absolute inset-0 cursor-pointer&quot;
+           onClick={handleCanvasClick}
+           onMouseMove={handleCanvasMouseMove}
+           onMouseLeave={() =&gt; setHoveredTask(null)}
+           style={{ width: &#39;100%&#39;, height: &#39;100%&#39; }}
+         /&gt;
+ 
+         {selectedTask &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;div className=&quot;absolute top-2 right-2 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-lg shadow-lg p-3 max-w-xs&quot;&gt;
+             &lt;h4 className=&quot;font-semibold text-gray-900&quot;&gt;Task Details&lt;/h4&gt;
+             {(() =&gt; {
+               const task = data?.tasks.find(t =&gt; t.id === selectedTask);
+               return task ? (
+                 &lt;div className=&quot;mt-2 space-y-1&quot;&gt;
+                   &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Title:&lt;/strong&gt; {task.title}&lt;/p&gt;
+                   &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Status:&lt;/strong&gt; {task.status}&lt;/p&gt;
+                   &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Progress:&lt;/strong&gt; {task.progress}%&lt;/p&gt;
+                   &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Priority:&lt;/strong&gt; {task.priority}&lt;/p&gt;
+                   {task.assignedAgent &amp;&amp; &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Agent:&lt;/strong&gt; {task.assignedAgent}&lt;/p&gt;}
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               ) : null;
+             })()}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };

+ import React, { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from &#39;react&#39;;
+ import { invoke } from &#39;@tauri-apps/api/core&#39;;
+ import { z } from &#39;zod&#39;;
+ 
+ // Zod schemas for type safety
+ const TaskStatusSchema = z.union([
+   z.literal(&#39;todo&#39;),
+   z.literal(&#39;inProgress&#39;),
+   z.literal(&#39;review&#39;),
+   z.literal(&#39;done&#39;),
+ ]);
+ 
+ const ProjectTaskSchema = z.object({
+   readonly id: z.string(),
+   readonly title: z.string(),
+   readonly description: z.string().optional(),
+   readonly assignedAgent: z.string().optional(),
+   readonly status: TaskStatusSchema,
+   readonly dueDate: z.string().optional(),
+   readonly priority: z.union([z.literal(&#39;low&#39;), z.literal(&#39;medium&#39;), z.literal(&#39;high&#39;)]),
+   readonly progress: z.number().min(0).max(100),
+ });
+ 
+ type TaskStatus = z.infer&lt;typeof TaskStatusSchema&gt;;
+ type ProjectTask = z.infer&lt;typeof ProjectTaskSchema&gt;;
+ 
+ interface ProjectManagementTableProps {
+   readonly className?: string;
+   readonly onTaskClick?: (task: ProjectTask) =&gt; void;
+   readonly onTaskUpdate?: (taskId: string, updates: Partial&lt;ProjectTask&gt;) =&gt; void;
+   readonly onExport?: (format: &#39;csv&#39; | &#39;excel&#39;) =&gt; void;
+ }
+ 
+ // Table column configuration
+ interface ColumnConfig {
+   readonly key: keyof ProjectTask;
+   readonly label: string;
+   readonly sortable: boolean;
+   readonly filterable: boolean;
+   readonly width?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ const COLUMNS: readonly ColumnConfig[] = [
+   { key: &#39;title&#39;, label: &#39;Title&#39;, sortable: true, filterable: true, width: &#39;200px&#39; },
+   { key: &#39;description&#39;, label: &#39;Description&#39;, sortable: false, filterable: true, width: &#39;250px&#39; },
+   { key: &#39;assignedAgent&#39;, label: &#39;Assigned Agent&#39;, sortable: true, filterable: true, width: &#39;150px&#39; },
+   { key: &#39;status&#39;, label: &#39;Status&#39;, sortable: true, filterable: true, width: &#39;120px&#39; },
+   { key: &#39;priority&#39;, label: &#39;Priority&#39;, sortable: true, filterable: true, width: &#39;100px&#39; },
+   { key: &#39;progress&#39;, label: &#39;Progress&#39;, sortable: true, filterable: false, width: &#39;120px&#39; },
+   { key: &#39;dueDate&#39;, label: &#39;Due Date&#39;, sortable: true, filterable: true, width: &#39;120px&#39; },
+ ];
+ 
+ // Status and priority display configurations
+ const STATUS_CONFIG: Record&lt;TaskStatus, { label: string; color: string; bgColor: string }&gt; = {
+   todo: { label: &#39;To Do&#39;, color: &#39;text-gray-700&#39;, bgColor: &#39;bg-gray-100&#39; },
+   inProgress: { label: &#39;In Progress&#39;, color: &#39;text-blue-700&#39;, bgColor: &#39;bg-blue-100&#39; },
+   review: { label: &#39;Review&#39;, color: &#39;text-yellow-700&#39;, bgColor: &#39;bg-yellow-100&#39; },
+   done: { label: &#39;Done&#39;, color: &#39;text-green-700&#39;, bgColor: &#39;bg-green-100&#39; },
+ };
+ 
+ const PRIORITY_CONFIG = {
+   low: { label: &#39;Low&#39;, color: &#39;text-gray-600&#39;, bgColor: &#39;bg-gray-100&#39; },
+   medium: { label: &#39;Medium&#39;, color: &#39;text-yellow-600&#39;, bgColor: &#39;bg-yellow-100&#39; },
+   high: { label: &#39;High&#39;, color: &#39;text-red-600&#39;, bgColor: &#39;bg-red-100&#39; },
+ } as const;
+ 
+ // Sort and filter state
+ interface SortState {
+   readonly column: keyof ProjectTask;
+   readonly direction: &#39;asc&#39; | &#39;desc&#39;;
+ }
+ 
+ interface FilterState {
+   readonly [key: string]: string;
+ }
+ 
+ export const ProjectManagementTable: React.FC&lt;ProjectManagementTableProps&gt; = ({
+   className = &#39;&#39;,
+   onTaskClick,
+   onTaskUpdate,
+   onExport,
+ }) =&gt; {
+   const [tasks, setTasks] = useState&lt;readonly ProjectTask[]&gt;([]);
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+   const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);
+   const [sortState, setSortState] = useState&lt;SortState | null&gt;(null);
+   const [filterState, setFilterState] = useState&lt;FilterState&gt;({});
+   const [selectedTasks, setSelectedTasks] = useState&lt;Set&lt;string&gt;&gt;(new Set());
+   const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
+   const [pageSize] = useState(10);
+ 
+   // Load project tasks
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     loadTasks();
+   }, []);
+ 
+   const loadTasks = async () =&gt; {
+     try {
+       setLoading(true);
+       setError(null);
+ 
+       const loadedTasks = await invoke&lt;ProjectTask[]&gt;(&#39;get_all_project_tasks&#39;);
+       const validatedTasks = z.array(ProjectTaskSchema).parse(loadedTasks);
+ 
+       setTasks(validatedTasks);
+     } catch (err) {
+       console.error(&#39;Failed to load tasks:&#39;, err);
+       setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : &#39;Failed to load tasks&#39;);
+     } finally {
+       setLoading(false);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   // Filtered and sorted tasks
+   const processedTasks = useMemo(() =&gt; {
+     let result = [...tasks];
+ 
+     // Apply filters
+     Object.entries(filterState).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {
+       if (value.trim()) {
+         result = result.filter(task =&gt; {
+           const taskValue = task[key as keyof ProjectTask];
+           return taskValue?.toString().toLowerCase().includes(value.toLowerCase());
+         });
+       }
+     });
+ 
+     // Apply sorting
+     if (sortState) {
+       result.sort((a, b) =&gt; {
+         const aValue = a[sortState.column];
+         const bValue = b[sortState.column];
+ 
+         let comparison = 0;
+         if (aValue &lt; bValue) comparison = -1;
+         if (aValue &gt; bValue) comparison = 1;
+ 
+         return sortState.direction === &#39;desc&#39; ? -comparison : comparison;
+       });
+     }
+ 
+     return result;
+   }, [tasks, sortState, filterState]);
+ 
+   // Paginated tasks
+   const paginatedTasks = useMemo(() =&gt; {
+     const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
+     return processedTasks.slice(startIndex, startIndex + pageSize);
+   }, [processedTasks, currentPage, pageSize]);
+ 
+   const totalPages = Math.ceil(processedTasks.length / pageSize);
+ 
+   const handleSort = (column: keyof ProjectTask) =&gt; {
+     setSortState(prevState =&gt; {
+       if (prevState?.column === column) {
+         return {
+           column,
+           direction: prevState.direction === &#39;asc&#39; ? &#39;desc&#39; : &#39;asc&#39;,
+         };
+       }
+       return { column, direction: &#39;asc&#39; };
+     });
+   };
+ 
+   const handleFilter = (column: string, value: string) =&gt; {
+     setFilterState(prevState =&gt; ({
+       ...prevState,
+       [column]: value,
+     }));
+     setCurrentPage(1); // Reset to first page when filtering
+   };
+ 
+   const handleTaskSelect = (taskId: string, selected: boolean) =&gt; {
+     setSelectedTasks(prevState =&gt; {
+       const newState = new Set(prevState);
+       if (selected) {
+         newState.add(taskId);
+       } else {
+         newState.delete(taskId);
+       }
+       return newState;
+     });
+   };
+ 
+   const handleSelectAll = (selected: boolean) =&gt; {
+     if (selected) {
+       setSelectedTasks(new Set(paginatedTasks.map(task =&gt; task.id)));
+     } else {
+       setSelectedTasks(new Set());
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const handleBulkUpdate = async (updates: Partial&lt;ProjectTask&gt;) =&gt; {
+     try {
+       for (const taskId of selectedTasks) {
+         await invoke(&#39;update_project_task&#39;, { taskId, updates });
+         onTaskUpdate?.(taskId, updates);
+       }
+       await loadTasks(); // Reload tasks
+       setSelectedTasks(new Set());
+     } catch (err) {
+       console.error(&#39;Failed to update tasks:&#39;, err);
+       setError(&#39;Failed to update tasks&#39;);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const handleExport = (format: &#39;csv&#39; | &#39;excel&#39;) =&gt; {
+     onExport?.(format);
+   };
+ 
+   const renderCell = (task: ProjectTask, column: ColumnConfig) =&gt; {
+     const value = task[column.key];
+ 
+     switch (column.key) {
+       case &#39;status&#39;:
+         const statusConfig = STATUS_CONFIG[value as TaskStatus];
+         return (
+           &lt;span className={&#96;inline-flex items-center px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${statusConfig.color} ${statusConfig.bgColor}&#96;}&gt;
+             {statusConfig.label}
+           &lt;/span&gt;
+         );
+ 
+       case &#39;priority&#39;:
+         const priorityConfig = PRIORITY_CONFIG[value as keyof typeof PRIORITY_CONFIG];
+         return (
+           &lt;span className={&#96;inline-flex items-center px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${priorityConfig.color} ${priorityConfig.bgColor}&#96;}&gt;
+             {priorityConfig.label}
+           &lt;/span&gt;
+         );
+ 
+       case &#39;progress&#39;:
+         return (
+           &lt;div className=&quot;flex items-center space-x-2&quot;&gt;
+             &lt;div className=&quot;w-16 h-2 bg-gray-200 rounded-full&quot;&gt;
+               &lt;div
+                 className=&quot;h-full bg-blue-500 rounded-full transition-all duration-300&quot;
+                 style={{ width: &#96;${value}%&#96; }}
+               &gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;span className=&quot;text-xs text-gray-600&quot;&gt;{value}%&lt;/span&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         );
+ 
+       case &#39;dueDate&#39;:
+         return value ? new Date(value as string).toLocaleDateString() : &#39;-&#39;;
+ 
+       case &#39;description&#39;:
+         const desc = value as string | undefined;
+         return desc ? (
+           &lt;span className=&quot;truncate block max-w-xs&quot; title={desc}&gt;
+             {desc}
+           &lt;/span&gt;
+         ) : &#39;-&#39;;
+ 
+       default:
+         return value?.toString() || &#39;-&#39;;
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const renderTableHeader = () =&gt; (
+     &lt;thead className=&quot;bg-gray-50&quot;&gt;
+       &lt;tr&gt;
+         &lt;th className=&quot;px-4 py-3&quot;&gt;
+           &lt;input
+             type=&quot;checkbox&quot;
+             checked={selectedTasks.size === paginatedTasks.length &amp;&amp; paginatedTasks.length &gt; 0}
+             onChange={(e) =&gt; handleSelectAll(e.target.checked)}
+             className=&quot;rounded border-gray-300&quot;
+           /&gt;
+         &lt;/th&gt;
+         {COLUMNS.map(column =&gt; (
+           &lt;th
+             key={column.key}
+             className={&#96;px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider ${
+               column.sortable ? &#39;cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100&#39; : &#39;&#39;
+             }&#96;}
+             onClick={() =&gt; column.sortable &amp;&amp; handleSort(column.key)}
+             style={{ width: column.width }}
+           &gt;

+               &lt;span&gt;{column.label}&lt;/span&gt;
+               {column.sortable &amp;&amp; sortState?.column === column.key &amp;&amp; (

+                   {sortState.direction === &#39;asc&#39; ? &#39;↑&#39; : &#39;↓&#39;}
+                 &lt;/span&gt;
+               )}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+             {column.filterable &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;input
+                 type=&quot;text&quot;
+                 placeholder={&#96;Filter ${column.label.toLowerCase()}&#96;}
+                 value={filterState[column.key] || &#39;&#39;}
+                 onChange={(e) =&gt; handleFilter(column.key, e.target.value)}
+                 className=&quot;mt-1 block w-full text-xs border-gray-300 rounded px-2 py-1&quot;
+                 onClick={(e) =&gt; e.stopPropagation()}
+               /&gt;
+             )}
+           &lt;/th&gt;
+         ))}
+       &lt;/tr&gt;
+     &lt;/thead&gt;
+   );
+ 
+   const renderTableBody = () =&gt; (
+     &lt;tbody className=&quot;bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200&quot;&gt;
+       {paginatedTasks.map(task =&gt; (
+         &lt;tr
+           key={task.id}
+           className={&#96;hover:bg-gray-50 cursor-pointer ${selectedTasks.has(task.id) ? &#39;bg-blue-50&#39; : &#39;&#39;}&#96;}
+           onClick={() =&gt; onTaskClick?.(task)}
+         &gt;
+           &lt;td className=&quot;px-4 py-4&quot;&gt;
+             &lt;input
+               type=&quot;checkbox&quot;
+               checked={selectedTasks.has(task.id)}
+               onChange={(e) =&gt; handleTaskSelect(task.id, e.target.checked)}
+               onClick={(e) =&gt; e.stopPropagation()}
+               className=&quot;rounded border-gray-300&quot;

+           &lt;/td&gt;
+           {COLUMNS.map(column =&gt; (
+             &lt;td

+             &lt;/td&gt;
+           ))}
+         &lt;/tr&gt;
+       ))}
+     &lt;/tbody&gt;
+   );
+ 
+   const renderPagination = () =&gt; (
+     &lt;div className=&quot;bg-white px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-gray-200 sm:px-6&quot;&gt;
+       &lt;div className=&quot;flex-1 flex justify-between sm:hidden&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;button
+           onClick={() =&gt; setCurrentPage(Math.max(1, currentPage - 1))}
+           disabled={currentPage === 1}

+         &gt;
+           Previous
+         &lt;/button&gt;
+         &lt;button
+           onClick={() =&gt; setCurrentPage(Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + 1))}
+           disabled={currentPage === totalPages}
+           className=&quot;ml-3 relative inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 text-sm font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 disabled:opacity-50&quot;
+         &gt;
+           Next
+         &lt;/button&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;div className=&quot;hidden sm:flex-1 sm:flex sm:items-center sm:justify-between&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;div&gt;

+             Showing &lt;span className=&quot;font-medium&quot;&gt;{(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + 1}&lt;/span&gt; to{&#39; &#39;}
+             &lt;span className=&quot;font-medium&quot;&gt;{Math.min(currentPage * pageSize, processedTasks.length)}&lt;/span&gt; of{&#39; &#39;}
+             &lt;span className=&quot;font-medium&quot;&gt;{processedTasks.length}&lt;/span&gt; results

+ import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from &#39;react&#39;;

+   readonly values: z.array(z.number()),

+

+   readonly lowerWarningLimit: z.number(),

+ const QCChartDataSchema = z.object({

+   })),
+ });
+

+   },

+ 
+ // Control chart types

+   { value: &#39;r&#39;, label: &#39;R Chart&#39;, description: &#39;Range control chart&#39; },
+   { value: &#39;p&#39;, label: &#39;p Chart&#39;, description: &#39;Proportion defective control chart&#39; },
+   { value: &#39;np&#39;, label: &#39;np Chart&#39;, description: &#39;Number defective control chart&#39; },
+ ];
+ 
+ export const QCControlCharts: React.FC&lt;QCControlChartsProps&gt; = ({
+   className = &#39;&#39;,
+   height = 400,
+   metricName = &#39;Quality Metric&#39;,
+   subgroupSize = 5,
+   onViolationClick,
+ }) =&gt; {
+   const canvasRef = useRef&lt;HTMLCanvasElement&gt;(null);
+   const [chartData, setChartData] = useState&lt;QCChartData | null&gt;(null);
+   const [selectedChartType, setSelectedChartType] = useState&lt;ChartType&gt;(&#39;xbar&#39;);
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

+   const [hoveredPoint, setHoveredPoint] = useState&lt;{ index: number; value: number } | null&gt;(null);
+   const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState({ start: 0, end: 50 });
+ 
+   // Load QC chart data
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     loadQCData();

+ 
+   const loadQCData = async () =&gt; {

+       setLoading(false);

+

+ 
+     // Set canvas size
+     const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio;
+     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

+     // Horizontal grid lines

+ 
+     // Lower control limit

+     const chartHeight = height - CHART_CONFIG.margin.top - CHART_CONFIG.margin.bottom;
+ 
+     const xValues = chart.data.map(d =&gt; typeof d.x === &#39;number&#39; ? d.x : 0);
+     const yValues = chart.data.map(d =&gt; d.y);
+ 
+     const xMin = Math.min(...xValues);
+     const xMax = Math.max(...xValues);
+     const yMin = Math.min(...yValues);
+     const yMax = Math.max(...yValues);
+ 
+     const xRange = xMax - xMin || 1;
+     const yRange = yMax - yMin || 1;
+ 
+     // Draw points
+     chart.data.forEach((point, index) =&gt; {
+       const x = CHART_CONFIG.margin.left + (chartWidth * (xValues[index] - xMin) / xRange);
+       const y = height - CHART_CONFIG.margin.bottom - (chartHeight * (yValues[index] - yMin) / yRange);
+ 
+       ctx.fillStyle = CHART_CONFIG.colors[index % CHART_CONFIG.colors.length];
+       ctx.beginPath();
+       ctx.arc(x, y, 4, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
+       ctx.fill();
+ 
+       ctx.strokeStyle = &#39;#000&#39;;
+       ctx.lineWidth = 1;
+       ctx.stroke();
+     });
+ 
+     // Draw trend line if correlation data available
+     if (chart.statistics.correlation) {
+       drawTrendLine(ctx, width, height, chart.data, xMin, xMax, yMin, yMax);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const drawAnovaChart = (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, width: number, height: number, chart: StatisticalChartData) =&gt; {
+     const chartWidth = width - CHART_CONFIG.margin.left - CHART_CONFIG.margin.right;
+     const chartHeight = height - CHART_CONFIG.margin.top - CHART_CONFIG.margin.bottom;
+ 
+     // Draw F-distribution curve
+     const fStatistic = chart.statistics.fStatistic || 1.0;
+     const pValue = chart.statistics.pValue || 0.5;
+ 
+     // Draw bars for group means
+     const groups = new Map&lt;string, number[]&gt;();
+     chart.data.forEach(d =&gt; {
+       const group = d.group || &#39;Default&#39;;
+       if (!groups.has(group)) {
+         groups.set(group, []);
+       }
+       groups.get(group)!.push(d.y);
+     });
+ 
+     const groupArray = Array.from(groups.entries());
+     const barWidth = chartWidth / groupArray.length * 0.6;
+ 
+     groupArray.forEach(([group, values], index) =&gt; {
+       const mean = values.reduce((sum, val) =&gt; sum + val, 0) / values.length;
+       const x = CHART_CONFIG.margin.left + (chartWidth * (index + 0.5)) / groupArray.length;
+       const barHeight = (chartHeight * mean) / (chart.statistics.max || 1);
+       const y = height - CHART_CONFIG.margin.bottom - barHeight;
+ 
+       ctx.fillStyle = CHART_CONFIG.colors[index % CHART_CONFIG.colors.length];
+       ctx.fillRect(x - barWidth / 2, y, barWidth, barHeight);
+ 
+       ctx.strokeStyle = &#39;#000&#39;;
+       ctx.lineWidth = 1;
+       ctx.strokeRect(x - barWidth / 2, y, barWidth, barHeight);
+ 
+       // Draw error bars (standard deviation)
+       const stdDev = Math.sqrt(values.reduce((sum, val) =&gt; sum + Math.pow(val - mean, 2), 0) / values.length);
+       const errorBarHeight = (chartHeight * stdDev) / (chart.statistics.max || 1);
+ 
+       ctx.beginPath();
+       ctx.moveTo(x, y);
+       ctx.lineTo(x, y - errorBarHeight);
+       ctx.stroke();
+ 
+       ctx.beginPath();
+       ctx.moveTo(x - barWidth / 4, y - errorBarHeight);
+       ctx.lineTo(x + barWidth / 4, y - errorBarHeight);
+       ctx.stroke();
+     });
+   };
+ 
+   const drawCorrelationMatrix = (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, width: number, height: number, chart: StatisticalChartData) =&gt; {
+     const matrixSize = Math.min(width - CHART_CONFIG.margin.left - CHART_CONFIG.margin.right,
+                                height - CHART_CONFIG.margin.top - CHART_CONFIG.margin.bottom);
+     const cellSize = matrixSize / Math.sqrt(chart.data.length);
+ 
+     chart.data.forEach((point, index) =&gt; {
+       const row = Math.floor(index / Math.sqrt(chart.data.length));
+       const col = index % Math.floor(Math.sqrt(chart.data.length));
+ 
+       const x = CHART_CONFIG.margin.left + col * cellSize;
+       const y = CHART_CONFIG.margin.top + row * cellSize;
+ 
+       // Color based on correlation value
+       const correlation = typeof point.x === &#39;number&#39; ? point.x : 0;
+       const intensity = Math.abs(correlation);
+       const color = correlation &gt;= 0 ? [0, 100, 255 * intensity] : [255 * intensity, 0, 0];
+ 
+       ctx.fillStyle = &#96;rgb(${color[0]}, ${color[1]}, ${color[2]})&#96;;
+       ctx.fillRect(x, y, cellSize, cellSize);
+ 
+       ctx.strokeStyle = &#39;#000&#39;;
+       ctx.lineWidth = 1;
+       ctx.strokeRect(x, y, cellSize, cellSize);
+ 
+       // Draw correlation value
+       ctx.fillStyle = &#39;#fff&#39;;
+       ctx.font = &#39;12px sans-serif&#39;;
+       ctx.textAlign = &#39;center&#39;;
+       ctx.fillText(correlation.toFixed(2), x + cellSize / 2, y + cellSize / 2 + 4);
+     });
+   };
+ 
+   const drawNormalDistribution = (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, width: number, height: number, chart: StatisticalChartData) =&gt; {
+     const chartWidth = width - CHART_CONFIG.margin.left - CHART_CONFIG.margin.right;
+     const chartHeight = height - CHART_CONFIG.margin.top - CHART_CONFIG.margin.bottom;
+ 
+     const mean = chart.statistics.mean || 0;
+     const stdDev = chart.statistics.stdDev || 1;
+     const min = chart.statistics.min || mean - 3 * stdDev;
+     const max = chart.statistics.max || mean + 3 * stdDev;
+ 
+     // Draw histogram bars
+     const values = chart.data.map(d =&gt; d.y);
+     const binCount = 20;
+     const binWidth = (max - min) / binCount;
+     const bins = new Array(binCount).fill(0);
+ 
+     values.forEach(value =&gt; {
+       const binIndex = Math.min(binCount - 1, Math.floor((value - min) / binWidth));
+       bins[binIndex]++;
+     });
+ 
+     const maxBinHeight = Math.max(...bins);
+ 
+     // Draw histogram
+     bins.forEach((count, index) =&gt; {
+       const x = CHART_CONFIG.margin.left + (chartWidth * index) / binCount;
+       const barWidth = chartWidth / binCount;
+       const barHeight = (chartHeight * count) / maxBinHeight;
+       const y = height - CHART_CONFIG.margin.bottom - barHeight;
+ 
+       ctx.fillStyle = &#39;rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.5)&#39;;
+       ctx.fillRect(x, y, barWidth, barHeight);
+ 
+       ctx.strokeStyle = &#39;#3b82f6&#39;;
+       ctx.lineWidth = 1;
+       ctx.strokeRect(x, y, barWidth, barHeight);
+     });
+ 
+     // Draw normal distribution curve
+     ctx.strokeStyle = &#39;#ef4444&#39;;
+     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
+     ctx.beginPath();
+ 
+     for (let i = 0; i &lt;= 100; i++) {
+       const x = min + (max - min) * i / 100;
+       const y = normalPDF(x, mean, stdDev);
+       const normalizedY = y / normalPDF(mean, mean, stdDev); // Normalize to peak at 1
+ 
+       const canvasX = CHART_CONFIG.margin.left + (chartWidth * (x - min) / (max - min));
+       const canvasY = height - CHART_CONFIG.margin.bottom - (chartHeight * normalizedY * 0.8);
+ 
+       if (i === 0) {
+         ctx.moveTo(canvasX, canvasY);
+       } else {
+         ctx.lineTo(canvasX, canvasY);
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     ctx.stroke();
+   };
+ 
+   const drawTrendLine = (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, width: number, height: number,
+                         data: StatisticalChartData[&#39;data&#39;], xMin: number, xMax: number, yMin: number, yMax: number) =&gt; {
+     const chartWidth = width - CHART_CONFIG.margin.left - CHART_CONFIG.margin.right;
+     const chartHeight = height - CHART_CONFIG.margin.top - CHART_CONFIG.margin.bottom;
+ 
+     const n = data.length;
+     const sumX = data.reduce((sum, d) =&gt; sum + (typeof d.x === &#39;number&#39; ? d.x : 0), 0);
+     const sumY = data.reduce((sum, d) =&gt; sum + d.y, 0);
+     const sumXY = data.reduce((sum, d) =&gt; sum + (typeof d.x === &#39;number&#39; ? d.x : 0) * d.y, 0);
+     const sumXX = data.reduce((sum, d) =&gt; sum + Math.pow(typeof d.x === &#39;number&#39; ? d.x : 0, 2), 0);
+ 
+     const slope = (n * sumXY - sumX * sumY) / (n * sumXX - sumX * sumX);
+     const intercept = (sumY - slope * sumX) / n;
+ 
+     const startX = xMin;
+     const endX = xMax;
+     const startY = slope * startX + intercept;
+     const endY = slope * endX + intercept;
+ 
+     const canvasStartX = CHART_CONFIG.margin.left;
+     const canvasStartY = height - CHART_CONFIG.margin.bottom - (chartHeight * (startY - yMin) / (yMax - yMin));
+     const canvasEndX = width - CHART_CONFIG.margin.right;
+     const canvasEndY = height - CHART_CONFIG.margin.bottom - (chartHeight * (endY - yMin) / (yMax - yMin));
+ 
+     ctx.strokeStyle = &#39;#10b981&#39;;
+     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
+     ctx.beginPath();
+     ctx.moveTo(canvasStartX, canvasStartY);
+     ctx.lineTo(canvasEndX, canvasEndY);
+     ctx.stroke();
+   };
+ 
+   const drawChartAxes = (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, width: number, height: number, chart: StatisticalChartData) =&gt; {
+     // Draw axes
+     ctx.strokeStyle = &#39;#000&#39;;
+     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
+ 
+     // Y-axis
+     ctx.beginPath();
+     ctx.moveTo(CHART_CONFIG.margin.left, CHART_CONFIG.margin.top);
+     ctx.lineTo(CHART_CONFIG.margin.left, height - CHART_CONFIG.margin.bottom);
+     ctx.stroke();
+ 
+     // X-axis
+     ctx.beginPath();
+     ctx.moveTo(CHART_CONFIG.margin.left, height - CHART_CONFIG.margin.bottom);
+     ctx.lineTo(width - CHART_CONFIG.margin.right, height - CHART_CONFIG.margin.bottom);
+     ctx.stroke();
+ 
+     // Title
+     ctx.fillStyle = &#39;#000&#39;;
+     ctx.font = &#39;16px sans-serif&#39;;
+     ctx.textAlign = &#39;center&#39;;
+     ctx.fillText(chart.title, width / 2, CHART_CONFIG.margin.top - 10);
+   };
+ 
+   const percentile = (sortedArray: number[], p: number): number =&gt; {
+     const index = (p / 100) * (sortedArray.length - 1);
+     const lower = Math.floor(index);
+     const upper = Math.ceil(index);
+     const weight = index % 1;
+ 
+     if (upper &gt;= sortedArray.length) return sortedArray[sortedArray.length - 1];
+     return sortedArray[lower] * (1 - weight) + sortedArray[upper] * weight;
+   };
+ 
+   const normalPDF = (x: number, mean: number, stdDev: number): number =&gt; {
+     return Math.exp(-0.5 * Math.pow((x - mean) / stdDev, 2)) / (stdDev * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI));
+   };
+ 
+   if (loading) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className={&#96;flex items-center justify-center ${className}&#96;} style={{ height }}&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;text-gray-500&quot;&gt;Loading Statistical Analysis Charts...&lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   if (error) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className={&#96;flex items-center justify-center ${className}&#96;} style={{ height }}&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;text-red-500&quot;&gt;Error: {error}&lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   if (!analysisData) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className={&#96;flex items-center justify-center ${className}&#96;} style={{ height }}&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;text-gray-500&quot;&gt;No statistical data available&lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   const currentChart = analysisData.charts.find(chart =&gt; chart.chartType === selectedChartType);
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className={&#96;bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-lg overflow-hidden ${className}&#96;}&gt;
+       &lt;div className=&quot;bg-gray-50 px-4 py-3 border-b border-gray-200&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;flex items-center justify-between&quot;&gt;
+           &lt;div&gt;
+             &lt;h3 className=&quot;text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900&quot;&gt;Statistical Analysis Charts&lt;/h3&gt;
+             &lt;p className=&quot;text-sm text-gray-600&quot;&gt;Advanced statistical analysis and visualization&lt;/p&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+           &lt;div className=&quot;flex items-center space-x-4&quot;&gt;
+             &lt;select
+               value={selectedChartType}
+               onChange={(e) =&gt; setSelectedChartType(e.target.value as ChartType)}
+               className=&quot;border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-1 text-sm&quot;
+             &gt;
+               {CHART_TYPES.map(type =&gt; (
+                 &lt;option key={type.value} value={type.value}&gt;
+                   {type.label}
+                 &lt;/option&gt;
+               ))}
+             &lt;/select&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;button
+               onClick={loadStatisticalData}
+               className=&quot;px-3 py-1 bg-blue-500 text-white text-sm rounded hover:bg-blue-600&quot;
+             &gt;
+               Refresh
+             &lt;/button&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+         &lt;div className=&quot;mt-2 text-sm text-gray-600&quot;&gt;
+           {CHART_TYPES.find(t =&gt; t.value === selectedChartType)?.description}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;div className=&quot;relative p-4&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;canvas
+           ref={canvasRef}
+           className=&quot;border border-gray-200 rounded&quot;
+           style={{ width: &#39;100%&#39;, height }}
+         /&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Statistics summary */}
+         {currentChart &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;div className=&quot;mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4&quot;&gt;
+             {currentChart.statistics.mean !== undefined &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;div className=&quot;bg-blue-50 p-3 rounded-lg&quot;&gt;
+                 &lt;div className=&quot;text-sm text-blue-600 font-medium&quot;&gt;Mean&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div className=&quot;text-lg font-bold text-blue-900&quot;&gt;
+                   {currentChart.statistics.mean.toFixed(3)}
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             )}
+ 
+             {currentChart.statistics.stdDev !== undefined &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;div className=&quot;bg-green-50 p-3 rounded-lg&quot;&gt;
+                 &lt;div className=&quot;text-sm text-green-600 font-medium&quot;&gt;Std Dev&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div className=&quot;text-lg font-bold text-green-900&quot;&gt;
+                   {currentChart.statistics.stdDev.toFixed(3)}
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             )}
+ 
+             {currentChart.statistics.correlation !== undefined &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;div className=&quot;bg-purple-50 p-3 rounded-lg&quot;&gt;
+                 &lt;div className=&quot;text-sm text-purple-600 font-medium&quot;&gt;Correlation&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div className=&quot;text-lg font-bold text-purple-900&quot;&gt;
+                   {currentChart.statistics.correlation.toFixed(3)}
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             )}
+ 
+             {currentChart.statistics.pValue !== undefined &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;div className={&#96;p-3 rounded-lg ${
+                 currentChart.statistics.pValue &lt; 0.05 ? &#39;bg-red-50&#39; : &#39;bg-gray-50&#39;
+               }&#96;}&gt;
+                 &lt;div className={&#96;text-sm font-medium ${
+                   currentChart.statistics.pValue &lt; 0.05 ? &#39;text-red-600&#39; : &#39;text-gray-600&#39;
+                 }&#96;}&gt;
+                   p-value
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div className={&#96;text-lg font-bold ${
+                   currentChart.statistics.pValue &lt; 0.05 ? &#39;text-red-900&#39; : &#39;text-gray-900&#39;
+                 }&#96;}&gt;
+                   {currentChart.statistics.pValue.toFixed(4)}
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             )}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+ 
+         {/* Analysis summary */}
+         &lt;div className=&quot;mt-4 bg-gray-50 p-4 rounded-lg&quot;&gt;
+           &lt;h4 className=&quot;font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-2&quot;&gt;Analysis Summary&lt;/h4&gt;
+           &lt;div className=&quot;grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 text-sm&quot;&gt;
+             &lt;div&gt;
+               &lt;span className=&quot;text-gray-600&quot;&gt;Total Data Points:&lt;/span&gt;
+               &lt;span className=&quot;ml-2 font-medium&quot;&gt;{analysisData.summary.totalDataPoints}&lt;/span&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;div&gt;
+               &lt;span className=&quot;text-gray-600&quot;&gt;Significant Findings:&lt;/span&gt;

+             &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;div&gt;
+               &lt;span className=&quot;text-gray-600&quot;&gt;Quality Score:&lt;/span&gt;
+               &lt;span className=&quot;ml-2 font-medium&quot;&gt;{analysisData.summary.qualityScore.toFixed(2)}&lt;/span&gt;

+               &lt;span className=&quot;ml-2 font-medium&quot;&gt;
+                 {((1 - analysisData.summary.qualityScore) * 100).toFixed(1)}%
+               &lt;/span&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+           {analysisData.summary.recommendations.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (

+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}

+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };

+ import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from &#39;react&#39;;
+ import { invoke } from &#39;@tauri-apps/api/core&#39;;

+ 
+ // Component imports
+ import { ResourceControl } from &#39;../components/orchestration/ResourceControl&#39;;

+ import { RealtimeLogViewer } from &#39;../components/orchestration/RealtimeLogViewer&#39;;
