+ 
+ // Zod schemas for type safety
+ const DashboardMetricsSchema = z.object({
+   readonly totalTasks: z.number(),
+   readonly activeTasks: z.number(),
+   readonly completedTasks: z.number(),
+   readonly failedTasks: z.number(),
+   readonly qualityScore: z.number(),
+   readonly performanceScore: z.number(),
+   readonly resourceUtilization: z.number(),
+   readonly activeAgents: z.number(),
+ });
+ 
+ const SystemStatusSchema = z.object({
+   readonly overallHealth: z.union([z.literal(&#39;healthy&#39;), z.literal(&#39;warning&#39;), z.literal(&#39;critical&#39;)]),
+   readonly components: z.record(z.union([
+     z.literal(&#39;healthy&#39;),
+     z.literal(&#39;warning&#39;),
+     z.literal(&#39;critical&#39;),
+     z.literal(&#39;offline&#39;)
+   ])),
+   readonly alerts: z.array(z.object({
+     readonly id: z.string(),
+     readonly type: z.union([z.literal(&#39;info&#39;), z.literal(&#39;warning&#39;), z.literal(&#39;error&#39;)]),
+     readonly title: z.string(),
+     readonly message: z.string(),
+     readonly timestamp: z.string(),
+   })),
+ });
+ 
+ const WorktreeStatusSchema = z.object({
+   readonly name: z.string(),
+   readonly path: z.string(),
+   readonly branch: z.string(),
+   readonly agent: z.string(),
+   readonly status: z.union([z.literal(&#39;active&#39;), z.literal(&#39;idle&#39;), z.literal(&#39;error&#39;)]),
+   readonly lastActivity: z.string(),
+   readonly progress: z.number(),
+ });
+ 
+ type DashboardMetrics = z.infer&lt;typeof DashboardMetricsSchema&gt;;
+ type SystemStatus = z.infer&lt;typeof SystemStatusSchema&gt;;
+ type WorktreeStatus = z.infer&lt;typeof WorktreeStatusSchema&gt;;
+ 
+ interface ParallelDevelopmentDashboardProps {
+   readonly className?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ // Dashboard tabs
+ type DashboardTab = &#39;overview&#39; | &#39;project&#39; | &#39;quality&#39; | &#39;resources&#39; | &#39;logs&#39;;
+ 
+ export const ParallelDevelopmentDashboard: React.FC&lt;ParallelDevelopmentDashboardProps&gt; = ({
+   className = &#39;&#39;,
+ }) =&gt; {
+   const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState&lt;DashboardTab&gt;(&#39;overview&#39;);
+   const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState&lt;DashboardMetrics | null&gt;(null);
+   const [systemStatus, setSystemStatus] = useState&lt;SystemStatus | null&gt;(null);
+   const [worktrees, setWorktrees] = useState&lt;readonly WorktreeStatus[]&gt;([]);
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+   const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);
+   const intervalRef = useRef&lt;NodeJS.Timeout&gt;();
+ 
+   // Load dashboard data
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     loadDashboardData();
+ 
+     // Set up real-time updates
+     intervalRef.current = setInterval(loadDashboardData, 5000); // Update every 5 seconds
+ 
+     return () =&gt; {
+       if (intervalRef.current) {
+         clearInterval(intervalRef.current);
+       }
+     };
+   }, []);
+ 
+   const loadDashboardData = async () =&gt; {
+     try {
+       setLoading(true);
+       setError(null);
+ 
+       // Load all dashboard data in parallel
+       const [metricsData, systemStatusData, worktreesData] = await Promise.all([
+         invoke(&#39;get_dashboard_metrics&#39;),
+         invoke(&#39;get_system_status&#39;),
+         invoke(&#39;get_worktree_status&#39;),
+       ]);
+ 
+       const validatedMetrics = DashboardMetricsSchema.parse(metricsData);
+       const validatedSystemStatus = SystemStatusSchema.parse(systemStatusData);
+       const validatedWorktrees = z.array(WorktreeStatusSchema).parse(worktreesData);
+ 
+       setMetrics(validatedMetrics);
+       setSystemStatus(validatedSystemStatus);
+       setWorktrees(validatedWorktrees);
+     } catch (err) {
+       console.error(&#39;Failed to load dashboard data:&#39;, err);
+       setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : &#39;Failed to load dashboard data&#39;);
+     } finally {
+       setLoading(false);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const renderOverviewTab = () =&gt; (
+     &lt;div className=&quot;space-y-6&quot;&gt;
+       {/* Key Metrics Cards */}
+       &lt;div className=&quot;grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;MetricCard
+           title=&quot;Total Tasks&quot;
+           value={metrics?.totalTasks.toString() || &#39;0&#39;}
+           icon=&quot;📋&quot;
+           color=&quot;blue&quot;
+         /&gt;
+         &lt;MetricCard
+           title=&quot;Active Tasks&quot;
+           value={metrics?.activeTasks.toString() || &#39;0&#39;}
+           icon=&quot;⚡&quot;
+           color=&quot;green&quot;
+         /&gt;
+         &lt;MetricCard
+           title=&quot;Quality Score&quot;
+           value={&#96;${((metrics?.qualityScore || 0) * 100).toFixed(1)}%&#96;}
+           icon=&quot;🎯&quot;
+           color=&quot;purple&quot;
+         /&gt;
+         &lt;MetricCard
+           title=&quot;Resource Usage&quot;
+           value={&#96;${((metrics?.resourceUtilization || 0) * 100).toFixed(1)}%&#96;}
+           icon=&quot;💻&quot;
+           color=&quot;orange&quot;
+         /&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       {/* System Status */}
+       &lt;div className=&quot;bg-white rounded-lg shadow p-6&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;h3 className=&quot;text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4&quot;&gt;System Status&lt;/h3&gt;
+         {systemStatus &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;div className=&quot;space-y-4&quot;&gt;
+             &lt;div className=&quot;flex items-center&quot;&gt;
+               &lt;StatusIndicator status={systemStatus.overallHealth} /&gt;
+               &lt;span className=&quot;ml-2 text-sm font-medium&quot;&gt;
+                 Overall Health: {systemStatus.overallHealth.toUpperCase()}
+               &lt;/span&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;div className=&quot;grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4&quot;&gt;
+               {Object.entries(systemStatus.components).map(([component, status]) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;div key={component} className=&quot;flex items-center&quot;&gt;
+                   &lt;StatusIndicator status={status} /&gt;
+                   &lt;span className=&quot;ml-2 text-sm capitalize&quot;&gt;{component}&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               ))}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             {systemStatus.alerts.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;div className=&quot;mt-4&quot;&gt;
+                 &lt;h4 className=&quot;text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 mb-2&quot;&gt;Active Alerts&lt;/h4&gt;
+                 &lt;div className=&quot;space-y-2&quot;&gt;
+                   {systemStatus.alerts.slice(0, 3).map(alert =&gt; (
+                     &lt;AlertItem key={alert.id} alert={alert} /&gt;
+                   ))}
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             )}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       {/* Active Worktrees */}
+       &lt;div className=&quot;bg-white rounded-lg shadow p-6&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;h3 className=&quot;text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4&quot;&gt;Active Worktrees&lt;/h3&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;space-y-3&quot;&gt;
+           {worktrees.map(worktree =&gt; (
+             &lt;WorktreeCard key={worktree.name} worktree={worktree} /&gt;
+           ))}
+           {worktrees.length === 0 &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div className=&quot;text-center py-8 text-gray-500&quot;&gt;
+               No active worktrees
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ 
+   const renderProjectTab = () =&gt; (
+     &lt;div className=&quot;space-y-6&quot;&gt;
+       {/* Project Management Tools */}
+       &lt;div className=&quot;grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;space-y-6&quot;&gt;
+           &lt;GanttChart height={400} /&gt;
+           &lt;KanbanBoard /&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;div&gt;
+           &lt;ProjectManagementTable /&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ 
+   const renderQualityTab = () =&gt; (
+     &lt;div className=&quot;space-y-6&quot;&gt;
+       {/* Quality Control Tools */}
+       &lt;div className=&quot;grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;QCControlCharts height={400} /&gt;
+         &lt;StatisticalAnalysisCharts height={400} /&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ 
+   const renderResourcesTab = () =&gt; (
+     &lt;div className=&quot;space-y-6&quot;&gt;
+       {/* Resource Management */}
+       &lt;div className=&quot;grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;ResourceControl /&gt;
+         &lt;MCPAgentPanel /&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ 
+   const renderLogsTab = () =&gt; (
+     &lt;div className=&quot;space-y-6&quot;&gt;
+       {/* Real-time Logs */}
+       &lt;RealtimeLogViewer height={600} /&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ 
+   const renderTabContent = () =&gt; {
+     switch (activeTab) {
+       case &#39;overview&#39;:
+         return renderOverviewTab();
+       case &#39;project&#39;:
+         return renderProjectTab();
+       case &#39;quality&#39;:
+         return renderQualityTab();
+       case &#39;resources&#39;:
+         return renderResourcesTab();
+       case &#39;logs&#39;:
+         return renderLogsTab();
+       default:
+         return renderOverviewTab();
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   if (loading &amp;&amp; !metrics) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className={&#96;flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen ${className}&#96;}&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;text-center&quot;&gt;
+           &lt;div className=&quot;animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-blue-500 mx-auto mb-4&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;div className=&quot;text-gray-500&quot;&gt;Loading Dashboard...&lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   if (error) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className={&#96;flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen ${className}&#96;}&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;text-red-500 text-center&quot;&gt;
+           &lt;div className=&quot;text-lg font-semibold mb-2&quot;&gt;Dashboard Error&lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;div&gt;{error}&lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;button
+             onClick={loadDashboardData}
+             className=&quot;mt-4 px-4 py-2 bg-blue-500 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-600&quot;
+           &gt;
+             Retry
+           &lt;/button&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className={&#96;min-h-screen bg-gray-50 ${className}&#96;}&gt;
+       {/* Header */}
+       &lt;div className=&quot;bg-white shadow-sm border-b border-gray-200&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8&quot;&gt;
+           &lt;div className=&quot;flex items-center justify-between h-16&quot;&gt;
+             &lt;div className=&quot;flex items-center&quot;&gt;
+               &lt;h1 className=&quot;text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900&quot;&gt;
+                 Parallel Development Dashboard
+               &lt;/h1&gt;
+               &lt;div className=&quot;ml-4 flex items-center space-x-2&quot;&gt;
+                 &lt;div className={&#96;w-3 h-3 rounded-full ${
+                   systemStatus?.overallHealth === &#39;healthy&#39; ? &#39;bg-green-500&#39; :
+                   systemStatus?.overallHealth === &#39;warning&#39; ? &#39;bg-yellow-500&#39; : &#39;bg-red-500&#39;
+                 }&#96;}&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;span className=&quot;text-sm text-gray-600 capitalize&quot;&gt;
+                   {systemStatus?.overallHealth || &#39;unknown&#39;}
+                 &lt;/span&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;div className=&quot;flex items-center space-x-4&quot;&gt;
+               &lt;button
+                 onClick={loadDashboardData}
+                 className=&quot;px-3 py-2 bg-blue-500 text-white text-sm rounded hover:bg-blue-600 flex items-center&quot;
+               &gt;
+                 &lt;span className=&quot;mr-2&quot;&gt;🔄&lt;/span&gt;
+                 Refresh
+               &lt;/button&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       {/* Navigation Tabs */}
+       &lt;div className=&quot;bg-white shadow-sm&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8&quot;&gt;
+           &lt;nav className=&quot;flex space-x-8&quot;&gt;
+             {[
+               { id: &#39;overview&#39;, label: &#39;Overview&#39;, icon: &#39;📊&#39; },
+               { id: &#39;project&#39;, label: &#39;Project&#39;, icon: &#39;📋&#39; },
+               { id: &#39;quality&#39;, label: &#39;Quality&#39;, icon: &#39;🎯&#39; },
+               { id: &#39;resources&#39;, label: &#39;Resources&#39;, icon: &#39;⚙️&#39; },
+               { id: &#39;logs&#39;, label: &#39;Logs&#39;, icon: &#39;📝&#39; },
+             ].map(tab =&gt; (
+               &lt;button
+                 key={tab.id}
+                 onClick={() =&gt; setActiveTab(tab.id as DashboardTab)}
+                 className={&#96;flex items-center px-1 py-4 border-b-2 font-medium text-sm ${
+                   activeTab === tab.id
+                     ? &#39;border-blue-500 text-blue-600&#39;
+                     : &#39;border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300&#39;
+                 }&#96;}
+               &gt;
+                 &lt;span className=&quot;mr-2&quot;&gt;{tab.icon}&lt;/span&gt;
+                 {tab.label}
+               &lt;/button&gt;

+           &lt;/nav&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       {/* Main Content */}

+         {renderTabContent()}
+       &lt;/main&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ // Helper Components
+ 
+ interface MetricCardProps {
+   readonly title: string;
+   readonly value: string;
+   readonly icon: string;
+   readonly color: &#39;blue&#39; | &#39;green&#39; | &#39;purple&#39; | &#39;orange&#39; | &#39;red&#39;;
+ }
+ 
+ const MetricCard: React.FC&lt;MetricCardProps&gt; = ({ title, value, icon, color }) =&gt; {
+   const colorClasses = {
+     blue: &#39;bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200&#39;,
+     green: &#39;bg-green-50 text-green-700 border-green-200&#39;,
+     purple: &#39;bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border-purple-200&#39;,
+     orange: &#39;bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border-orange-200&#39;,
+     red: &#39;bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200&#39;,
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className={&#96;bg-white rounded-lg shadow p-6 border ${colorClasses[color]}&#96;}&gt;
+       &lt;div className=&quot;flex items-center&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;flex-shrink-0&quot;&gt;
+           &lt;span className=&quot;text-2xl&quot;&gt;{icon}&lt;/span&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;ml-4&quot;&gt;
+           &lt;h3 className=&quot;text-sm font-medium text-gray-900&quot;&gt;{title}&lt;/h3&gt;
+           &lt;p className=&quot;text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900&quot;&gt;{value}&lt;/p&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ interface StatusIndicatorProps {
+   readonly status: &#39;healthy&#39; | &#39;warning&#39; | &#39;critical&#39; | &#39;offline&#39;;
+ }
+ 
+ const StatusIndicator: React.FC&lt;StatusIndicatorProps&gt; = ({ status }) =&gt; {
+   const statusConfig = {
+     healthy: { color: &#39;bg-green-500&#39;, text: &#39;Healthy&#39; },
+     warning: { color: &#39;bg-yellow-500&#39;, text: &#39;Warning&#39; },
+     critical: { color: &#39;bg-red-500&#39;, text: &#39;Critical&#39; },
+     offline: { color: &#39;bg-gray-500&#39;, text: &#39;Offline&#39; },
+   };
+ 
+   const config = statusConfig[status];
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className=&quot;flex items-center&quot;&gt;
+       &lt;div className={&#96;w-3 h-3 rounded-full ${config.color}&#96;}&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;span className=&quot;ml-2 text-sm&quot;&gt;{config.text}&lt;/span&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ interface AlertItemProps {
+   readonly alert: SystemStatus[&#39;alerts&#39;][0];
+ }
+ 
+ const AlertItem: React.FC&lt;AlertItemProps&gt; = ({ alert }) =&gt; {
+   const typeConfig = {
+     info: { color: &#39;text-blue-600&#39;, bgColor: &#39;bg-blue-50&#39; },
+     warning: { color: &#39;text-yellow-600&#39;, bgColor: &#39;bg-yellow-50&#39; },
+     error: { color: &#39;text-red-600&#39;, bgColor: &#39;bg-red-50&#39; },
+   };
+ 
+   const config = typeConfig[alert.type];
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className={&#96;p-3 rounded-lg ${config.bgColor}&#96;}&gt;
+       &lt;div className=&quot;flex items-start&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;flex-shrink-0&quot;&gt;
+           &lt;span className={&#96;text-sm font-medium ${config.color}&#96;}&gt;
+             {alert.type === &#39;info&#39; ? &#39;ℹ️&#39; : alert.type === &#39;warning&#39; ? &#39;⚠️&#39; : &#39;❌&#39;}
+           &lt;/span&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;ml-3&quot;&gt;
+           &lt;h4 className={&#96;text-sm font-medium ${config.color}&#96;}&gt;{alert.title}&lt;/h4&gt;
+           &lt;p className=&quot;text-sm text-gray-700&quot;&gt;{alert.message}&lt;/p&gt;
+           &lt;p className=&quot;text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1&quot;&gt;
+             {new Date(alert.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
+           &lt;/p&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ interface WorktreeCardProps {
+   readonly worktree: WorktreeStatus;
+ }
+ 
+ const WorktreeCard: React.FC&lt;WorktreeCardProps&gt; = ({ worktree }) =&gt; {
+   const statusConfig = {
+     active: { color: &#39;text-green-600&#39;, bgColor: &#39;bg-green-100&#39;, icon: &#39;🟢&#39; },
+     idle: { color: &#39;text-gray-600&#39;, bgColor: &#39;bg-gray-100&#39;, icon: &#39;⚪&#39; },
+     error: { color: &#39;text-red-600&#39;, bgColor: &#39;bg-red-100&#39;, icon: &#39;🔴&#39; },
+   };
+ 
+   const config = statusConfig[worktree.status];
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className=&quot;flex items-center justify-between p-4 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-lg&quot;&gt;
+       &lt;div className=&quot;flex items-center space-x-3&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;span className=&quot;text-lg&quot;&gt;{config.icon}&lt;/span&gt;
+         &lt;div&gt;
+           &lt;h4 className=&quot;font-medium text-gray-900&quot;&gt;{worktree.name}&lt;/h4&gt;
+           &lt;p className=&quot;text-sm text-gray-600&quot;&gt;
+             {worktree.agent} • {worktree.branch}

+ 
+       &lt;div className=&quot;flex items-center space-x-4&quot;&gt;

+             {worktree.status}
+           &lt;/span&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
